Headline: #57 Laramie Temporary Northbound Reroute near Laramie/Lake
ShortDescription: Northbound #57 Laramie buses are temporarily rerouted due to, street blockage near Laramie/Lake.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #57 Laramie buses are temporarily rerouted due to, street blockage near Laramie/Lake.

Northbound #57 Laramie buses are temporarily rerouted via Laramie, Madison, Cicero, Chicago and Laramie.

Southbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
